name: tezos-baker
description: Tezos baker setup for Ghostnet testnet

scripts.env: test -f .env && echo '.env file found' || (echo 'Error: .env file not found. Copy .env.example to .env first.' && exit 1)
scripts.node:init: npm run env && . ./.env && mkdir -p ${DATA_DIR:-data} && docker run --rm --entrypoint octez-node -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} config init --network ${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet} --history-mode ${HISTORY_MODE:-rolling} --rpc-addr 0.0.0.0:${RPC_PORT:-8732} --net-addr 0.0.0.0:${P2P_PORT:-9732} --data-dir /var/run/tezos/node
scripts.node:identity: npm run env && . ./.env && docker run --rm --entrypoint octez-node -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} identity generate --data-dir /var/run/tezos/node
scripts.node:version: npm run env && . ./.env && docker run --rm --entrypoint sh -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} -c 'echo "{\"version\": \"3.2\"}" > /var/run/tezos/node/version.json'
scripts.node:start: npm run env && . ./.env && docker run -d --name ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node --entrypoint octez-node -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" -p ${RPC_PORT:-8732}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} -p ${P2P_PORT:-9732}:${P2P_PORT:-9732} -p ${METRICS_PORT:-9095}:${METRICS_PORT:-9095} tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} run --network ${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet} --data-dir /var/run/tezos/node
scripts.node:restart: npm run node:stop && npm run node:start
scripts.node:status: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} rpc get /chains/main/blocks/head/header
scripts.node:bootstrap: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} bootstrapped
scripts.node:head: npm run env && . ./.env && curl -s http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732}/chains/main/blocks/head/header | jq '{level, timestamp, hash}'
scripts.node:connections: npm run env && . ./.env && curl -s http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732}/network/connections | jq 'length' && echo 'active connections'
scripts.snapshot:download: npm run env && . ./.env && mkdir -p ${BACKUP_DIR:-backups} && cd ${BACKUP_DIR:-backups} && wget -O ${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet}-rolling.snapshot https://snapshots.tzinit.org/${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet}/rolling
scripts.snapshot:check: npm run env && . ./.env && ls -lh ${BACKUP_DIR:-backups}/${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet}-rolling.snapshot 2>/dev/null && echo 'Expected size: ~1.6G' || echo 'Snapshot not found. Run: npm run snapshot:download'
scripts.snapshot:import: npm run env && . ./.env && docker run --rm --entrypoint octez-node -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" -v "$PWD/${BACKUP_DIR:-backups}:/backups:ro" tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} snapshot import /backups/${TEZOS_NETWORK:-ghostnet}-rolling.snapshot --data-dir /var/run/tezos/node
scripts.account:create: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} gen keys ${BAKER_ALIAS:-alice}
scripts.account:show: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} show address ${BAKER_ALIAS:-alice}
scripts.account:balance: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} get balance for ${BAKER_ALIAS:-alice}
scripts.delegate:register: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} register key ${BAKER_ALIAS:-alice} as delegate
scripts.baker:start: npm run env && . ./.env && docker run -d --name ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-baker --network container:${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}:/var/run/tezos/node" -v "$PWD/${DATA_DIR:-data}/.tezos-client:/home/tezos/.tezos-client" --entrypoint octez-baker-${PROTOCOL:-PtSeouLo} tezos/tezos:${OCTEZ_VERSION:-octez-v23.1} run with local node /var/run/tezos/node --without-dal --liquidity-baking-toggle-vote pass ${BAKER_ALIAS:-alice}
scripts.baker:rights: npm run env && . ./.env && docker exec ${CONTAINER_PREFIX:-tezos}-node octez-client --endpoint http://${RPC_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}:${RPC_PORT:-8732} rpc get /chains/main/blocks/head/helpers/baking_rights
scripts.setup: npm run node:init && npm run node:identity && npm run node:version && echo 'Setup complete! Run: npm run node:start'
scripts.setup:snapshot: npm run setup && npm run snapshot:download && echo 'Download complete! Stop node, run: npm run snapshot:import, then restart'
scripts.clean:data: npm run env && . ./.env && npm run clean && rm -rf ${DATA_DIR:-data}/*
